title: Heart and Rose Sorceress
description: A woman in a green and purple hooded gown sits on a teal couch in a surreal room, writing in a book with one hand while holding a glowing blue anatomical heart in the other. To her left stands a large ornate painting of a pink rose with blue roots in a bowl, surrounded by floating lips, tentacles, and multiple faces emerging from swirling purple smoke.
prompt: A sorceress in a rich emerald green gown and purple hooded cloak sits on a teal vintage couch writing in an open book, holding a glowing blue anatomical heart in her left hand. Beside her is a large ornate blue-framed painting of a vibrant pink rose growing from blue organic roots in a bowl. The background shows a mosaic wall, floating giant lips with teeth, swirling purple smoke tentacles, and multiple small faces emerging from the smoke, dark whimsical surreal atmosphere.
